Tomato___Early_blight.symptoms: Dark brown to black spots with concentric rings ('bullseye' pattern) starting on lower older leaves, yellowing halos around lesions.
precautions: Prune and burn/dispose of lower infected leaves immediately to prevent upward spore splash.
Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation; switch strictly to root drip irrigation to keep foliage dry.
Ensure adequate plant spacing (60cm x 45cm) to promote good air circulation.
Tomato___Early_blight.organic_treatment: Spray Neem oil (0.5%) or Trichoderma viride / harzianum bio-fungicide @ 5g/L during early morning.
Tomato___Early_blight.chemical_treatment: Apply Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L or Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2g/L at 10-day intervals if disease incidence exceeds 10%.
Tomato___Early_blight.prevention: Practice 3-year crop rotation avoiding Solanaceous crops (potato, eggplant). Mulch the soil bed with straw to prevent soil splash.

hi.title: टमाटर - अगेती झुलसा (अर्ली ब्लाइट)
hi.action: निचली संक्रमित पत्तियों को तुरंत तोड़कर खेत से दूर नष्ट करें। पत्तों पर सीधे पानी का छिड़काव न करें, ड्रिप सिंचाई अपनाएं। नीम तेल या मेंकोजेब का छिड़काव करें।

gu.title: ટામેટા - પાનનો સુકારો (અર્લી બ્લાઇટ)
gu.action: ચેપગ્રસ્ત નીચેના પાંદડા તરત જ કાપીને નાશ કરો. પાંદડા પર ઉપરથી પાણી છાંટવાનું ટાળો, ડ્રિપ પદ્ધતિ વાપરો. લીમડાનું તેલ અથવા મેન્કોઝેબનો છંટકાવ કરો.

mr.title: टोमॅटो - लवकर येणारा करपा (अगेती करपा)
mr.action: खालची बाधित पाने ताबडतोब खुडून नष्ट करा. ठिबक सिंचन वापरा. निंबोळी अर्क किंवा मँकोझेब २.५ ग्रॅम प्रति लिटर फवारा.

Tomato___Late_blight.symptoms: Water-soaked irregular pale green lesions turning dark brown rapidly; white fuzzy fungal growth on undersides of leaves during humid weather.
precautions: Quarantine the affected plot; Late Blight spreads aggressively across entire fields within 48-72 hours under wet cool conditions.
Destroy heavily infested plants immediately to protect remaining crop.
Cease all foliar sprays and overhead watering immediately.
Tomato___Late_blight.organic_treatment: Foliar spray with Copper Hydroxide or Bordeaux mixture (1%) as a protective protective shield.
Tomato___Late_blight.chemical_treatment: Spray Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP (Ridomil MZ) @ 2g/L or Cymoxanil + Mancozeb @ 2g/L at first sign of infection.
Tomato___Late_blight.prevention: Plant certified disease-free resistant varieties. Avoid planting near potato fields.

hi.title: टमाटर - पछेती झुलसा (लेट ब्लाइट)
hi.action: यह अत्यंत तीव्र बीमारी है। संक्रमित पौधों को तुरंत नष्ट करें। रिडोमिल (Metalaxyl + Mancozeb) 2 ग्राम प्रति लीटर पानी में मिलाकर तुरंत छिड़कें।

gu.title: ટામેટા - પાછોતરો સુકારો (લેટ બ્લાઇટ)
gu.action: આ રોગ ખૂબ ઝડપથી ફેલાય છે. અસરગ્રસ્ત છોડને તાત્કાલિક બાળી નાખો અને રિડોમિલ એમઝેડ ૨ ગ્રામ પ્રતિ લિટર પાણીમાં ભેળવી છંટકાવ કરો.

mr.title: टोमॅटो - उशिरा येणारा करपा (लेट ब्लाइट)
mr.action: हा रोग वेगाने पसरतो. बाधित झाडे त्वरित नष्ट करा. रिडोमिल एमझेड २ ग्रॅम प्रति लिटर पाण्यात मिसळून ताबडतोब फवारणी करा.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.symptoms: Pale green to yellowish spots on upper leaf surfaces; olive-green to brown velvety fungal patches on lower leaf surfaces.
precautions: Improve greenhouse/polyhouse ventilation to lower relative humidity below 80%.
Prune sucker branches and lower leaves to maximize airflow.
Space rows widely and ensure good sunlight penetration.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.organic_treatment: Spray Bacillus subtilis bio-fungicide or compost tea extract.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.chemical_treatment: Apply Difenoconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L or Azoxystrobin @ 1ml/L if humidity remains above 85%.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.prevention: Ensure optimal daytime ventilation in protected cultivation; sanitize polyhouse structures.

hi.title: टमाटर - पत्ती का फफूंद (लीफ मोल्ड)
hi.action: हवा का संचार बढ़ाएं और नमी 80% से कम रखें। प्रभावित पत्तियां हटाएं और डाईफेनोकोनाजोल का छिड़काव करें।

gu.title: ટામેટા - પાનની ફૂગ (લીફ મોલ્ડ)
gu.action: હવાની અવરજવર વધારો અને ભેજ નિયંત્રિત કરો. રોગગ્રસ્ત પાન દૂર કરી યોગ્ય ફૂગનાશકનો ઉપયોગ કરો.

mr.title: टोमॅटो - पानांवरील बुरशी (लीफ मोल्ड)
mr.action: हवेचे खेळते प्रमाण वाढवा. कॉपर ऑक्सिक्लोराईड २.५ ग्रॅम प्रति लिटर किंवा बोर्डो मिश्रण १% फवारा.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small, water-soaked dark circular spots (less than 3mm) on leaves, stems, and fruits, often surrounded by yellow halos.
precautions: Do not work in fields when leaves are wet to prevent spreading bacteria via hands and tools.
Sterilize all pruning shears and stakes with 10% sodium hypochlorite solution.
Remove severely infected seedlings immediately.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.organic_treatment: Apply Copper sulfate + hydrated lime (Bordeaux mixture 0.5%) or Streptomyces bio-bactericide.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.chemical_treatment: Spray Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5g/L mixed with Streptocycline @ 0.1g/L (1g per 10 liters water).
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use certified hot-water treated seeds. Rotate with non-host crops like maize or sorghum.

hi.title: टमाटर - जीवाणु धब्बा रोग (बैक्टीरियल स्पॉट)
hi.action: गीले पौधों को हाथ न लगाएं। कॉपर ऑक्सीक्लोराइड 2.5 ग्राम + स्ट्रेप्टोसाइक्लिन 1 ग्राम प्रति 10 लीटर पानी में मिलाकर छिड़कें।

gu.title: ટામેટા - જીવાણુ ડાઘ (બેક્ટેરિયલ સ્પોટ)
gu.action: ભીના પાંદડાઓને અડકશો નહીં. કોપર ઓક્સીક્લોરાઇડ અને સ્ટ્રેપ્ટોસાયક્લિનનું મિશ્રણ બનાવી છંટકાવ કરો.

mr.title: टोमॅटो - जिवाणूजन्य ठिपके (बॅक्टेरियल स्पॉट)
mr.action: स्ट्रेप्टोसायक्लिन १ ग्रॅम + कॉपर ऑक्सिक्लोराईड ३० ग्रॅम प्रति १० लिटर पाण्यात मिसळून फवारा.

Tomato___healthy.symptoms: Deep green foliage, robust stems, no chlorosis, necrotic spotting, or fungal sporulation.
precautions: Maintain regular drip irrigation scheduling according to soil moisture sensor readings.
Apply balanced NPK fertilization (19:19:19 @ 5g/L foliar or fertigation).
Inspect undersides of leaves weekly for early pest/vector presence (whiteflies, aphids).
Tomato___healthy.organic_treatment: Preventative neem oil spray (3ml/L) every 14 days as prophylactic defense.
Tomato___healthy.chemical_treatment: No chemical application required. Save input costs.
Tomato___healthy.prevention: Continue good agricultural practices (GAP), mulch maintenance, and timely weeding.

hi.title: टमाटर - स्वस्थ पौधा
hi.action: पौधा पूरी तरह स्वस्थ है। किसी भी रासायनिक छिड़काव की आवश्यकता नहीं है। संतुलित पोषण और ड्रिप सिंचाई जारी रखें।

gu.title: ટામેટા - તંદુરસ્ત છોડ
gu.action: છોડ સંપૂર્ણપણે સ્વસ્થ છે. કોઈ દવાની જરૂર નથી. નિયમિત પાણી અને ખાતરની માવજત ચાલુ રાખો.

mr.title: टोमॅटो - निरोगी पीक
mr.action: पीक पूर्णपणे निरोगी आणि सशक्त आहे. नियमित निरीक्षण ठेवा आणि संतुलित खत व्यवस्थापन चालू ठेवा.

Potato___Early_blight.symptoms: Brown to black concentric target-board lesions on older leaves, causing leaf drying and premature defoliation.
precautions: Maintain adequate soil nitrogen and potassium; nutrient-stressed potato crops are more susceptible.
Avoid wounding potato foliage during cultivation.
Do not irrigate late in the evening.
Potato___Early_blight.organic_treatment: Spray Trichoderma viride formulation @ 4g/L on foliage.
Potato___Early_blight.chemical_treatment: Foliar application of Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2g/L or Propineb 70% WP @ 2g/L.
Potato___Early_blight.prevention: Ensure balanced nutrition, certified seed tubers, and destroy volunteer potato plants.

hi.title: आलू - अगेती झुलसा
hi.action: संतुलित नाइट्रोजन और पोटाश खाद दें। शाम के समय सिंचाई से बचें। मेंकोजेब 2 ग्राम प्रति लीटर पानी का छिड़काव करें।

gu.title: બટાટા - અર્લી બ્લાઇટ
gu.action: છોડને યોગ્ય પોષણ આપો. સાંજે પાણી આપવાનું ટાળો. મેન્કોઝેબ ૨ ગ્રામ પ્રતિ લિટર પાણીમાં છાંટો.

mr.title: बटाटा - लवकर येणारा करपा (अगेती करपा)
mr.action: बाधित पाने शेतातून काढून नष्ट करा. मॅन्कोझेब २.५ ग्रॅम किंवा कॉपर हायड्रॉक्साइड २ ग्रॅम प्रति लिटर फवारा.

Potato___Late_blight.symptoms: Rapidly expanding water-soaked black-brown blights with white mildew underneath; tuber rotting with reddish-brown dry rot.
precautions: Monitor weather: High relative humidity (>90%) with temperatures between 10-20°C creates high alert.
Hill up soil well around tuber rows to prevent zoospores washing down into tubers.
Kill potato haulms (vines) 10-14 days before harvest if late blight is active in the area.
Potato___Late_blight.chemical_treatment: Immediately spray Dimethomorph 50% WP @ 1g/L + Mancozeb @ 2g/L or Fenamidone + Mancozeb (Sectin) @ 2.5g/L.
Potato___Late_blight.prevention: Plant resistant cultivars (e.g. Kufri Girdhari, Kufri Himalini). Use only certified disease-free seed tubers.

hi.title: आलू - पछेती झुलसा (लेट ब्लाइट)
hi.action: मौसम में नमी बढ़ते ही सतर्क रहें। तुरंत डाइमेथोमोर्फ + मेंकोजेब का छिड़काव करें। मिट्टी चढ़ाएं ताकि कंद सुरक्षित रहें।

gu.title: બટાટા - પાછોતરો સુકારો (લેટ બ્લાઇટ)
gu.action: ખેતરમાં ભેજ વધતાં જ રોગ ફેલાય છે. તાત્કાલિક ડાઇમેથોમોર્ફ અને મેન્કોઝેબનો છંટકાવ કરો અને થડ પાસે માટી ચડાવો.

mr.title: बटाटा - उशिरा येणारा करपा (लेट ब्लाइट)
mr.action: हवामानात जास्त आर्द्रता असल्यास सायमोक्सॅनील + मॅन्कोझेब किंवा रिडोमिल २.५ ग्रॅम प्रति लिटर त्वरित फवारा.

Potato___healthy.symptoms: Lush emerald foliage, uniform vegetative canopy, clean leaf undersides.
precautions: Keep soil moisture at 65-75% available water capacity during tuber initiation and bulking.
Earth up soil around plants to protect developing tubers from sun greening and tuber moth.
Scout foliage 2-3 times a week.
Potato___healthy.organic_treatment: Weekly inspection; apply seaweed extract @ 2ml/L for vigorous root and tuber growth.
Potato___healthy.prevention: Maintain proper ridging and clean drainage ditches to prevent waterlogging.

hi.title: आलू - स्वस्थ पौधा
hi.action: पौधा रोगमुक्त और स्वस्थ है। आलू के कंदों के विकास के लिए मिट्टी चढ़ाएं और जलभराव न होने दें।

gu.title: બટાટા - તંદુરસ્ત છોડ
gu.action: છોડ એકદમ સ્વસ્થ છે. બટાટા સારા બેસે તે માટે પાળા ચડાવો અને પાણી ભરાવા ન દો.

mr.title: बटाटा - निरोगी पीक
mr.action: बटाट्याची पाने निरोगी आहेत. झाडांना नियमित भर द्या आणि पाण्याचा निचरा व्यवस्थित ठेवा.

Corn___Common_rust.symptoms: Cinnamon-brown oval to elongate pustules (uredinia) on both leaf surfaces that rupture the epidermis to release powdery spores.
precautions: Monitor upper canopy leaves before and during tassel stage.
Avoid planting susceptible hybrid varieties in late-planted fields.
Early detected pustules on lower leaves can be tolerated if weather turns warm and dry (>30°C).
Corn___Common_rust.organic_treatment: Apply bio-control agents or sulfur dust @ 15-20 kg/ha in early morning.
Corn___Common_rust.chemical_treatment: Spray Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC (Amistar Top) @ 1ml/L or Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L.
Corn___Common_rust.prevention: Plant rust-resistant hybrids; follow recommended planting dates to avoid high spore flights.

hi.title: मक्का - सामान्य गेरूई (कॉमन रस्ट)
hi.action: पत्तियों पर भूरे रंग के उभरे हुए दाने दिखाई देते हैं। प्रोपिकोनाजोल 1 मिली प्रति लीटर पानी में मिलाकर छिड़कें।

gu.title: મકાઈ - ગેરુ રોગ (કોમન રસ્ટ)
gu.action: પાંદડા પર બદામી રંગના ફોલ્લા જોવા મળે છે. પ્રોપીકોનાઝોલ ૧ મિલી પ્રતિ લિટર પાણીમાં છાંટો.

mr.title: मका - तांबेरा रोग (कॉमन रस्ट)
mr.action: मँकोझेब २.५ ग्रॅम किंवा प्रॉपिकोनाझोल १ मिली प्रति लिटर पाण्यात मिसळून रोगाच्या सुरुवातीला फवारा.

Corn___Gray_leaf_spot.symptoms: Narrow, rectangular lesions restricted by leaf veins (gray to tan in color), merging to blight large leaf areas.
precautions: Avoid minimum tillage or continuous corn-on-corn without residue burial.
Scout fields during silking and grain fill stages.
Ensure balanced soil potassium levels.
Corn___Gray_leaf_spot.organic_treatment: Foliar application of fermented cow urine + neem leaf extract (5%).
Corn___Gray_leaf_spot.chemical_treatment: Spray Pyraclostrobin 20% WG @ 1g/L or Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L when lesions reach two leaves below ear leaf.
Corn___Gray_leaf_spot.prevention: Practice crop rotation with soybeans or pulses. Plant hybrids with high tolerance ratings.

hi.title: मक्का - धूसर पर्ण दाग (ग्रे लीफ स्पॉट)
hi.action: आयताकार भूरे-धूसर धब्बे नसों के बीच बनते हैं। दलहनी फसलों के साथ फसल चक्र अपनाएं और पाइराक्लोस्ट्रोबिन का छिड़काव करें।

gu.title: મકાઈ - રાખોડી ટપકાનો રોગ (ગ્રે લીફ સ્પોટ)
gu.action: પાંદડાની નસો વચ્ચે લંબચોરસ ડાઘ પડે છે. પાકની ફેરબદલી કરો અને યોગ્ય ફૂગનાશકનો ઉપયોગ કરો.

mr.title: मका - राखाडी पानांचे ठिपके (ग्रे लीफ स्पॉट)
mr.action: अझॉक्सीस्ट्रोबिन + डिफेनोकोनाझोल १ मिली प्रति लिटर फवारा. पिकांची फेरपालट करा.

Corn___healthy.symptoms: Broad dark green leaves, erect stature, thick stalks, absence of foliar lesions or discoloration.
precautions: Ensure sufficient irrigation during critical silking and grain filling phases.
Apply split dose of Urea/Nitrogen at knee-high and tassel initiation stages.
Regularly inspect whorl for fall armyworm larvae.
Corn___healthy.organic_treatment: Install pheromone traps (5 traps/acre) for preventative pest surveillance.
Corn___healthy.prevention: Optimal row spacing (60 x 20 cm) and timely weed management in early 30 days.

hi.title: मक्का - स्वस्थ फसल
hi.action: मक्का की फसल पूर्णतः स्वस्थ है। घुटने की ऊंचाई और दाना बनते समय उचित सिंचाई और यूरिया की खुराक दें।

gu.title: મકાઈ - તંદુરસ્ત પાક
gu.action: પાક સંપૂર્ણપણે નિરોગી છે. ફૂલ અને દાણા બેસવાના સમયે જરૂરી પાણી અને નાઇટ્રોજન ખાતર આપો.

mr.title: मका - निरोगी पीक
mr.action: मका पीक पूर्णपणे निरोगी आहे. नत्र खताचा दुसरा हप्ता वेळेवर द्या आणि सिंचन व्यवस्थापन योग्य ठेवा.

Apple___Apple_scab.symptoms: Dull olive-green to black velvety spots on leaves and fruit, causing leaf crinkling and fruit corky cracking.
precautions: Rake and shred or compost fallen apple leaves in autumn to eliminate primary winter ascospore inoculum.
Prune orchard canopy to allow maximum sunlight and rapid leaf drying.
Monitor Mills infection periods following rain events.
Apple___Apple_scab.organic_treatment: Apply wettable sulfur @ 3g/L or lime sulfur dormant sprays.
Apple___Apple_scab.chemical_treatment: Spray Difenoconazole 25% EC @ 0.3ml/L or Captan 50% WP @ 2.5g/L at pink bud or petal fall stage.
Apple___Apple_scab.prevention: Plant scab-resistant cultivars (e.g. Florina, Prima, Enterprise).

hi.title: सेब - स्कैब रोग (खुरंड)
hi.action: पत्तियों और फलों पर काले-जैतूनी धब्बे पड़ते हैं। गिरे हुए पत्तों को नष्ट करें और कैप्टान या डाईफेनोकोनाजोल का छिड़काव करें।

gu.title: સફરજન - સ્કેબ રોગ
gu.action: પાંદડા અને ફળો પર કાળા ડાઘ પડે છે. બગીચાની સફાઈ રાખો અને કેપ્ટન અથવા ડાઇફેનોકોનાઝોલનો છંટકાવ કરો.

mr.title: सफरचंद - खरुज रोग (ॲपल स्कॅब)
mr.action: गळून पडलेली पाने गोळा करून नष्ट करा. कॅप्टन ५०% डब्ल्यूपी २ ग्रॅम किंवा मॅन्कोझेब २.५ ग्रॅम प्रति लिटर फवारा.

Apple___Black_rot.symptoms: Frogeye leaf spots (purple margins with tan centers), black sunken limb cankers, and completely mummified black rotting fruit.
precautions: Prune out dead wood, fire blight strikes, and cankers at least 15 cm below infected tissue.
Remove all mummified fruit hanging on trees or lying on orchard floor.
Sanitize pruning tools between cuts with 70% alcohol.
Apple___Black_rot.organic_treatment: Bordeaux mixture (1%) applied before bud burst.
Apple___Black_rot.chemical_treatment: Spray Thiophanate Methyl 70% WP @ 1g/L or Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L.
Apple___Black_rot.prevention: Control insect injuries that create entry points for spores; maintain tree vigor.

hi.title: सेब - ब्लैक रॉट (काला सड़न)
hi.action: सुखी टहनियों और सड़े हुए फलों (ममी) को पेड़ से काटकर दूर फेंकें। थायोफिनेट मिथाइल 1 ग्राम प्रति लीटर पानी का छिड़काव करें।

gu.title: સફરજન - બ્લેક રોટ (કાળો સડો)
gu.action: સૂકી ડાળીઓ અને સડેલા ફળો દૂર કરો. થિયોફિનેટ મિથાઇલ ૧ ગ્રામ પ્રતિ લિટર પાણીમાં છાંટો.

mr.title: सफरचंद - काळा कूज रोग (ब्लॅक रॉट)
mr.action: वाळलेल्या फांद्या कापून काढा. कॉपर ऑक्सिक्लोराईड ३ ग्रॅम प्रति लिटर किंवा थायोफॅनेट मिथाईल १ ग्रॅम फवारा.

Apple___healthy.symptoms: Vibrant foliage, clean fruit surface, absence of cankers or spotting.
precautions: Ensure proper basin irrigation or micro-sprinkler system during fruit development.
Apply calcium chloride foliar sprays (0.5%) to prevent bitter pit in fruit flesh.
Maintain tree canopy training and summer pruning for sunlight exposure.
Apple___healthy.organic_treatment: Apply compost and bio-fertilizers around tree basin in early spring.
Apple___healthy.prevention: Routine orchard hygiene and tree canopy management.

hi.title: सेब - स्वस्थ पेड़
hi.action: सेब का पेड़ स्वस्थ है। फलों के विकास के लिए संतुलित सिंचाई और कैल्शियम का स्प्रे करें।

gu.title: સફરજન - તંદુરસ્ત ઝાડ
gu.action: ઝાડ સંપૂર્ણપણે સ્વસ્થ છે. ફળોના સારા વિકાસ માટે યોગ્ય સિંચાઈ અને કેલ્શિયમ આપો.

mr.title: सफरचंद - निरोगी पाने
mr.action: झाडाची पाने सशक्त व निरोगी आहेत. फळांच्या वाढीसाठी सूक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्यांची फवारणी करा.

Grape___Black_rot.symptoms: Reddish-brown circular leaf spots with dark margins and tiny black pycnidia; infected berries turn into hard, black, shriveled mummies.
precautions: Prune vines to open up the fruit zone to maximum aeration and direct sunlight.
Remove and destroy all mummified grape clusters during winter dormant pruning.
Cultivate or bury vineyard floor litter to cover overwintering ascocarps.
Grape___Black_rot.organic_treatment: Spray Copper Hydroxide or Lime Sulfur during pre-bloom stage.
Grape___Black_rot.chemical_treatment: Spray Myclobutanil 10% WP @ 0.5g/L or Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 0.5ml/L at 10-14 day intervals.
Grape___Black_rot.prevention: Maintain diligent spray schedules from bud break through 4 weeks post-bloom.

hi.title: अंगूर - ब्लैक रॉट (काला सड़न)
hi.action: अंगूर के गुच्छों में सूखे काले फल तुरंत हटाएं। हवा और धूप के लिए छंटाई करें और माइक्लोबुटानिल का छिड़काव करें।

gu.title: દ્રાક્ષ - કાળો સડો (બ્લેક રોટ)
gu.action: સુકાઈ ગયેલી દ્રાક્ષની લૂમો દૂર કરો. સૂર્યપ્રકાશ મળે તે રીતે વેલાની છાંટણી કરો અને યોગ્ય ફૂગનાશક વાપરો.

mr.title: द्राक्ष - काळा कूज (ब्लॅक रॉट)
mr.action: हवेचे खेळते प्रमाण वाढवा. मॅन्कोझेब २.५ ग्रॅम किंवा मायक्लोब्युटॅनिल ०.५ ग्रॅम प्रति लिटर पाण्यात फवारा.

Grape___healthy.symptoms: Glossy green vine canopy, firm healthy fruit clusters with natural bloom, clear canes.
precautions: Practice regulated deficit irrigation (RDI) after veraison for high berry brix/sugar content.
Maintain canopy training (Bower or Y-trellis system) to prevent microclimate moisture traps.
Monitor vine petiole nutrient analysis.
Grape___healthy.organic_treatment: Potassium silicate foliar spray (2ml/L) to strengthen cuticle defenses.
Grape___healthy.prevention: Canopy shoot thinning and berry thinning as per yield targets.

hi.title: अंगूर - स्वस्थ बेल
hi.action: अंगूर की बेल स्वस्थ है। अच्छी मिठास और गुणवत्ता के लिए जल प्रबंधन और बेल की सही छंटाई बनाए रखें।

gu.title: દ્રાક્ષ - તંદુરસ્ત વેલો
gu.action: દ્રાક્ષનો વેલો સ્વસ્થ છે. સારી ગુણવત્તા માટે નિયમિત કાળજી અને સિંચાઈ નિયંત્રણ જાળવો.

mr.title: द्राक्ष - निरोगी वेल
mr.action: द्राक्षाची पाने निरोगी आहेत. कॅनोपी व्यवस्थापन चांगले ठेवा आणि अतिरिक्त वाढ नियंत्रित करा.

Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Water-soaked circular or irregular dark brown spots on leaves, becoming necrotic and causing heavy lower leaf drop; rough scabby spots on fruit.
precautions: Avoid handling pepper plants when wet with morning dew or rain.
Disinfect greenhouse benches, trays, and transplanting tools with bleach or quaternary ammonium.
Immediately rogue and bury badly infected pepper seedlings.
Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.organic_treatment: Spray copper sulfate (Bordeaux mixture 0.5%) or systemic acquired resistance (SAR) inducers.
Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.chemical_treatment: Apply Copper Hydroxide 77% WP @ 2g/L tank-mixed with Streptocycline @ 0.1g/L at 7-day intervals during warm rainy weather.
Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use certified pathogen-free seeds; do not plant after tomato or eggplant for 2-3 years.

hi.title: शिमला मिर्च - जीवाणु धब्बा रोग
hi.action: गीले पौधों को न छुएं। कॉपर हाइड्रोक्साइड 2 ग्राम + स्ट्रेप्टोसाइक्लिन 1 ग्राम प्रति 10 लीटर पानी में मिलाकर तुरंत छिड़कें।

gu.title: કેપ્સીકમ મરચાં - જીવાણુ ડાઘ
gu.action: ભીના છોડમાં કામ ન કરો. કોપર હાઇડ્રોક્સાઇડ અને સ્ટ્રેપ્ટોસાયક્લિનના દ્રાવણનો છંટકાવ કરો.

mr.title: ढोबळी मिरची - जिवाणूजन्य ठिपके
mr.action: कॉपर हायड्रॉक्साइड २ ग्रॅम + स्ट्रेप्टोसायक्लिन ०.१ ग्रॅम प्रति लिटर पाण्यात मिसळून फवारणी करा.

Pepper__bell___healthy.symptoms: Thick dark green foliage, vigorous branching, clean flowers and bell peppers free from blemishes.
precautions: Maintain consistent soil moisture to prevent blossom end rot (calcium deficiency induced by dry-wet swings).
Apply calcium nitrate fertigation @ 3g/L during fruit set.
Provide light shading (shade net 35%) during harsh summer heat waves.
Pepper__bell___healthy.organic_treatment: Apply vermicompost and neem cake to root zone.
Pepper__bell___healthy.prevention: Drip fertigation and silver-black reflective plastic mulch to deter thrips and aphids.

hi.title: शिमला मिर्च - स्वस्थ पौधा
hi.action: पौधा पूर्णतः स्वस्थ है। फलों को सड़न से बचाने के लिए नियमित सिंचाई और कैल्शियम युक्त खाद दें।

gu.title: કેપ્સીકમ મરચાં - તંદુરસ્ત છોડ
gu.action: છોડ સંપૂર્ણપણે તંદુરસ્ત છે. ફળોના સારા વિકાસ માટે નિયમિત પાણી અને કેલ્શિયમ આપો.

mr.title: ढोबळी मिरची - निरोगी पीक
mr.action: मिरचीचे पीक निरोगी आहे. मावा व तुडतुडे नियंत्रणासाठी पिवळे चिकट सापळे लावा.

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.symptoms: Bright yellow-orange or reddish spots on upper leaf surfaces; cup-shaped structures (aecia) producing powdery orange spores on leaf undersides.
precautions: Remove Eastern red cedar or juniper trees within 1-2 miles if possible.
Prune infected branches and gall formations during dormant winter period.
Avoid planting susceptible apple varieties near cedar windbreaks.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.organic_treatment: Spray sulfur-based bio-fungicide or Copper hydroxide at tight cluster to petal fall stage.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.chemical_treatment: Apply Myclobutanil (Systhane) @ 1.5g/L or Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L at 7 to 10 day intervals during spring spore release.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.prevention: Plant rust-resistant apple cultivars (such as Enterprise, Freedom, Liberty).

hi.title: सेब - सीडर रस्ट (गेरुआ रोग)
hi.action: संक्रमित शाखाओं की छंटाई करें। कवकनाशी माइक्लोब्युटानिल या मेंकोजेब का छिड़काव करें।

gu.title: સફરજન - સીડર રસ્ટ રોગ
gu.action: ચેપી ડાળીઓ કાપો. માયક્લોબ્યુટાનિલ અથવા મેન્કોઝેબનો છંટકાવ કરો.

mr.title: सफरचंद - सीडर रस्ट
mr.action: सफरचंदावरील नारिंगी डागांसाठी मायक्लोब्युटानिल किंवा मँकोझेब फवारा.

Blueberry___healthy.symptoms: Vibrant green, smooth, elliptical foliage with no lesions, wilting, or fungal discoloration.
precautions: Maintain acidic soil pH between 4.5 and 5.2.
Apply pine bark mulch (5-8 cm depth) to conserve soil moisture.
Ensure regular irrigation during berry development.
Blueberry___healthy.organic_treatment: Apply organic compost and elemental sulfur to maintain acidic rhizosphere.
Blueberry___healthy.chemical_treatment: No chemical fungicide required. Maintain standard micronutrient foliar spray (chelated iron).
Blueberry___healthy.prevention: Regular field sanitization, drip irrigation, and annual canopy pruning.

hi.title: ब्लूबेरी - स्वस्थ पौधा
hi.action: फसल पूर्णतः स्वस्थ है। मिट्टी का पीएच 4.5-5.2 बनाए रखें।

gu.title: બ્લુબેરી - તંદુરસ્ત પાક
gu.action: પાક સંપૂર્ણ સ્વસ્થ છે. જમીનમાં ભેજ જાળવી રાખો.

mr.title: ब्लूबेरी - निरोगी पीक
mr.action: झाड पूर्णपणे निरोगी आहे. योग्य खत आणि पाणी द्या.

Cherry___Powdery_mildew.symptoms: White powdery fungal patches on leaf surfaces and young shoots; curling, distortion, and premature defoliation.
precautions: Prune inner canopy to improve solar penetration and reduce relative humidity.
Avoid excessive nitrogen fertilization which stimulates overly succulent susceptible growth.
Remove and destroy infected water sprouts.
Cherry___Powdery_mildew.organic_treatment: Spray Potassium bicarbonate (3g/L) or wettable sulfur (2g/L) early in the morning.
Cherry___Powdery_mildew.chemical_treatment: Apply Triadimefon 25% WP @ 1g/L or Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1ml/L at petal fall and shuck fall.
Cherry___Powdery_mildew.prevention: Ensure good orchard ventilation and practice dormant oil sprays.

hi.title: चेरी - चूर्णिल आसिता (पाउडरी मिल्ड्यू)
hi.action: पत्तियों पर सफेद चूर्ण दिखने पर घुलनशील गंधक (Sulfur) या टेबुकोनाज़ोल का छिड़काव करें।

gu.title: ચેરી - ભૂકી છારો (પાવડરી માઇલ્ડ્યુ)
gu.action: સફેદ પાવડર જેવા ડાઘા માટે સલ્ફર અથવા ટેબુકોનાઝોલનો છંટકાવ કરો.

mr.title: चेरी - भुरी रोग
mr.action: पानांवर पांढऱ्या बुरशीसाठी विद्राव्य गंधक किंवा टेबुकोनॅझोल फवारा.

Cherry___healthy.symptoms: Deep green glossy leaves without spots, powdery fungal coating, or necrotic edges.
precautions: Ensure regular irrigation during fruit swell and stone hardening.
Protect against frost during spring bloom.
Conduct light summer pruning to balance canopy aeration.
Cherry___healthy.organic_treatment: Apply organic sea-weed extract or vermicompost tea as foliar tonic.
Cherry___healthy.chemical_treatment: No fungicide needed. Apply balanced NPK 10:10:10 after harvest.
Cherry___healthy.prevention: Sanitize pruning shears between trees and maintain mulch layer.

hi.title: चेरी - स्वस्थ पौधा
hi.action: पौधा रोगमुक्त और स्वस्थ है। नियमित सिंचाई और संतुलित पोषण दें।

gu.title: ચેરી - તંદુરસ્ત પાક
gu.action: ઝાડ તંદુરસ્ત છે. નિયમિત પાણી આપો.

mr.title: चेरी - निरोगी पीक
mr.action: झाड उत्तम स्थितीत आहे. योग्य निगा राखा.

Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.symptoms: Long, elliptical cigar-shaped grayish-green to tan lesions (2.5 to 15 cm long) with smooth margins progressing from lower leaves upward.
precautions: Shred and plow down crop debris after harvest to bury fungal inocula.
Avoid high plant densities that restrict inter-row air velocity.
Rotate maize with non-host crops (soybean, groundnut) for at least 2 seasons.
Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.organic_treatment: Apply Bacillus subtilis or Trichoderma viride foliar sprays @ 5g/L.
Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.chemical_treatment: Apply Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC @ 1ml/L or Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L at tasseling.
Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.prevention: Sow resistant maize hybrids and avoid continuous monocropping.

hi.title: मक्का - उत्तरी पत्ती झुलसा (नार्दन लीफ ब्लाइट)
hi.action: सिगार के आकार के भूरे धब्बों के लिए एजॉक्सीस्ट्रोबिन या मेंकोजेब का छिड़काव करें।

gu.title: મકાઈ - પાનનો મોટો સુકારો
gu.action: મોટા લાંબા ડાઘા માટે એઝોક્સીસ્ટ્રોબિન અથવા મેન્કોઝેબ છાંટો.

mr.title: मका - करपा (लीफ ब्लाइट)
mr.action: लांबट करड्या डागांसाठी मॅन्कोझेब किंवा अझॉक्सीस्ट्रॉबिन फवारा.

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).symptoms: Tiger-stripe leaf pattern with interveinal yellowing and necrosis surrounded by dark margins; berries show dark purple measles-like spots.
precautions: Disinfect pruning shears in 70% isopropyl alcohol between vines.
Delay pruning until late winter to minimize wound infection window.
Paint all pruning wounds greater than 1 cm with pruning wound sealant containing fungicide.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).organic_treatment: Treat fresh pruning wounds with Trichoderma atroviride protective paste.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).chemical_treatment: Paint pruning cuts with thiophanate-methyl or copper octanoate paste immediately after cutting.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).prevention: Remove dead wood and avoid stress on young grapevines.

hi.title: अंगूर - एस्का / ब्लैक मीसल्स
hi.action: पत्तियों पर धारियों और छंटाई के घावों पर कवकनाशी पेस्ट लगाएं। संक्रमित बेलों को चिन्हित करें।

gu.title: દ્રાક્ષ - એસ્કા રોગ
gu.action: છાંટેલા ભાગ પર બોર્ડો મિશ્રણ લગાવો અને વાઈનયાર્ડ સ્વચ્છ રાખો.

mr.title: द्राक्ष - एस्का (काळी देवी)
mr.action: छाटणीच्या जखमांवर बुरशीनाशक पेस्ट लावा आणि बाधित वेली वेगळ्या ठेवा.

Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.symptoms: Irregular dark brown necrotic spots on upper leaf surfaces; velvety olive-brown spore layer on lower surfaces; premature leaf dropping.
precautions: Ensure optimal canopy management and lateral shoot thinning to facilitate airflow.
Collect and destroy fallen infected leaves before bud break.
Avoid sprinkler irrigation wetting the vineyard foliage.
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.organic_treatment: Spray Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5g/L or Bordeaux Mixture (1%).
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.chemical_treatment: Spray Carbendazim 50% WP @ 1g/L or Kresoxim-methyl 44.3% SC @ 0.7ml/L at 12-day intervals.
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.prevention: Regular canopy management and post-harvest sanitation.

hi.title: अंगूर - पत्ती झुलसा (इसारियोप्सिस लीफ स्पॉट)
hi.action: पत्तियों पर भूरे धब्बों के लिए कार्बेन्डाजिम या कॉपर ऑक्सीक्लोराइड का छिड़काव करें।

gu.title: દ્રાક્ષ - પાનનો સુકારો
gu.action: તાંબાયુક્ત દવા અથવા કાર્બેન્ડાઝિમનો છંટકાવ કરો.

mr.title: द्राक्ष - पानावरील ठिपके
mr.action: कॉपर ऑक्सिक्लोराईड किंवा कार्बेन्डाझिमची फवारणी करा.

Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).pathogen: Candidatus Liberibacter asiaticus (Bacteria vectored by Asian Citrus Psyllid)
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).symptoms: Asymmetric blotchy mottling on leaves, vein yellowing, corky veins, lopsided small bitter fruit with dark aborted seeds.
precautions: Rigorously manage and control Asian Citrus Psyllid vector populations using sticky traps and insecticidal sprays.
Uproot and burn severely infected trees to prevent orchard-wide transmission.
Plant only certified pathogen-free nursery budwood.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).organic_treatment: Foliar spray with Neem oil (2%) + fish amino acid and balanced zinc/iron micronutrient correction.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).chemical_treatment: Control vector with Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.5ml/L or Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.3g/L. Apply Tetracycline antibiotic trunk injection under expert supervision.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).prevention: Strict psyllid vector management and elimination of infected source trees.

hi.title: संतरा / नींबू - साइट्रस ग्रीनिंग (हुआंगलोंगबिंग)
hi.action: यह अत्यंत गंभीर रोग है। कीट (सिट्रस साइला) को इमिडाक्लोप्रिड से नियंत्रित करें और सूक्ष्म पोषक तत्व दें।

gu.title: સંતરા / લીંબુ - સાઇટ્રસ ગ્રીનિંગ રોગ
gu.action: સાયલા કીટક નિયંત્રણ માટે ઇમિડાક્લોપ્રિડ છાંટો અને સૂક્ષ્મ પોષક તત્વો આપો.

mr.title: संत्रा - सायट्रस ग्रीनिंग
mr.action: मावा/सायला कीटकांचे नियंत्रण करा. झाडांना जस्त व लोहाचा पुरवठा करा.

Peach___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Angular water-soaked spots turning purple-black; centers fall out giving a 'shot-hole' appearance; fruit exhibits cracked dark lesions.
precautions: Avoid high-nitrogen fertilizer applications that generate soft lush growth.
Plant windbreaks to reduce windblown sand and rain abrasions.
Disinfect pruning equipment between orchard blocks.
Peach___Bacterial_spot.organic_treatment: Apply Copper sulfate pentahydrate or Copper Hydroxide at low rates during early foliage.
Peach___Bacterial_spot.chemical_treatment: Apply Streptocycline @ 0.1g/L + Copper Oxychloride @ 2g/L or Oxytetracycline during shuck split to petal fall.
Peach___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Plant bacterial spot tolerant peach cultivars (e.g. Biscoe, Candor).

hi.title: आड़ू (पीच) - जीवाणु धब्बा रोग (बैक्टीरियल स्पॉट)
hi.action: पत्तियों में छेद होने पर स्ट्रेप्टोसाइक्लिन और कॉपर ऑक्सीक्लोराइड का छिड़काव करें।

gu.title: પીચ - બેક્ટેરિયલ સ્પોટ રોગ
gu.action: પાંદડા પરના કાણાં માટે સ્ટ્રેપ્ટોસાયક્લીન અને કોપર દવાનો છંટકાવ કરો.

mr.title: पीच - जिवाणूजन्य ठिपके (शॉट-होल)
mr.action: स्ट्रेप्टोमायसीन आणि कॉपर ऑक्सिक्लोराईडची फवारणी करा.

Peach___healthy.symptoms: Lush lanceolate deep green leaves free of bacterial shot-holes, leaf curl, or cankers.
precautions: Maintain soil drainage; peach roots are susceptible to waterlogging.
Apply balanced annual fertilizer based on soil testing.
Dormant copper spray in late winter to prevent Peach Leaf Curl.
Peach___healthy.organic_treatment: Foliar application of bio-stimulants and neem cake around base.
Peach___healthy.chemical_treatment: No fungicide needed. Routine pest scouting for peach fruit borer.
Peach___healthy.prevention: Annual open-center training pruning and adequate summer irrigation.

hi.title: आड़ू (पीच) - स्वस्थ पौधा
hi.action: फसल स्वस्थ है। उचित जल निकासी और संतुलित उर्वरक प्रबंधन बनाए रखें।

gu.title: પીચ - તંદુરસ્ત પાક
gu.action: ઝાડ તંદુરસ્ત છે. જમીનમાં પાણી ભરાવા ન દો.

mr.title: पीच - निरोगी पीक
mr.action: पीक निरोगी आहे. पाणी साचू देऊ नका आणि योग्य खते द्या.

Raspberry___healthy.symptoms: Compound serrated deep green leaves without yellow mosaic veins, rust pustules, or cane blights.
precautions: Trellis canes off the ground to improve sun exposure and reduce soil-splash.
Prune out fruited floricanes immediately after harvesting.
Maintain 8 cm woodchip mulch.
Raspberry___healthy.organic_treatment: Compost dressing and foliar micronutrient seaweed spray.
Raspberry___healthy.chemical_treatment: None required. Maintain root rot protection with good drainage.
Raspberry___healthy.prevention: Select disease-free canes and maintain adequate inter-row spacing.

hi.title: रास्पबेरी - स्वस्थ पौधा
hi.action: पौधा रोगमुक्त है। जड़ों के पास पानी न जमने दें और मल्चिंग करें।

gu.title: રાસબેરી - તંદુરસ્ત પાક
gu.action: પાક તંદુરસ્ત છે. જમીનમાં સેન્દ્રિય ખાતર ઉમેરો.

mr.title: रास्पबेरी - निरोगी पीक
mr.action: पीक उत्तम स्थितीत आहे. नियमित छाटणी करा.

Soybean___healthy.symptoms: Trifoliate clean green leaves with vibrant chlorophyll and healthy active root nodules.
precautions: Inoculate seeds with Rhizobium japonicum before sowing.
Ensure weed-free environment during first 45 days after emergence.
Monitor for early pest emergence (stem fly, girdle beetle).
Soybean___healthy.organic_treatment: Soil application of Trichoderma viride and Pseudomonas fluorescens.
Soybean___healthy.chemical_treatment: No fungicide needed. Apply balanced phosphorus and potash.
Soybean___healthy.prevention: Crop rotation with wheat or maize and ridge-and-furrow planting.

hi.title: सोयाबीन - स्वस्थ पौधा
hi.action: सोयाबीन की फसल पूरी तरह स्वस्थ है। खेत में जलभराव न होने दें।

gu.title: સોયાબીન - તંદુરસ્ત પાક
gu.action: પાક તંદુરસ્ત છે. નીંદણ નિયંત્રણ યોગ્ય સમયે કરો.

mr.title: सोयाबीन - निरोगी पीक
mr.action: सोयाबीन पीक निरोगी आहे. योग्य वेळी तणनियंत्रण करा.

Squash___Powdery_mildew.symptoms: White flour-like fungal talcum powder spots on upper and lower surfaces of leaves and stems; leaves turn yellow, brown, and brittle.
precautions: Provide ample spacing between vines to permit unimpeded air movement.
Switch to drip irrigation to prevent foliar splashing.
Avoid overhead evening irrigation that extends humidity duration.
Squash___Powdery_mildew.organic_treatment: Foliar spray with Milk solution (1:9 ratio with water) or Potassium Bicarbonate (4g/L) or Neem oil (0.5%).
Squash___Powdery_mildew.chemical_treatment: Apply Dinocap 48% EC @ 1ml/L or Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1ml/L or Difenoconazole 25% EC @ 0.5ml/L upon initial spot sighting.
Squash___Powdery_mildew.prevention: Grow powdery-mildew resistant squash varieties and destroy crop refuse promptly.

hi.title: कद्दू / तोरई (स्क्वैश) - चूर्णिल आसिता (पाउडरी मिल्ड्यू)
hi.action: सफेद पाउडर जैसे धब्बों के लिए घुलनशील गंधक या एजॉक्सीस्ट्रोबिन का छिड़काव करें।

gu.title: કોળું / દૂધી - ભૂકી છારો (પાવડરી માઇલ્ડ્યુ)
gu.action: સફેદ પાવડર જેવા રોગ માટે દૂધનું મિશ્રણ અથવા અઝોક્સીસ્ટ્રોબિન છાંટો.

mr.title: भोपळा / वेलवर्गीय - भुरी रोग
mr.action: पानांवरील पांढऱ्या बुरशीसाठी पोटॅशियम बायकार्बोनेट किंवा अझॉक्सीस्ट्रॉबिन फवारा.

Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.symptoms: Numerous irregular purple-to-dark brown blotches on upper leaf surfaces without light centers; whole leaf turns brown and scorched at margins.
precautions: Mow, rake, and burn old leaves after harvest season.
Maintain narrow plant rows to allow leaves to dry rapidly after rain.
Avoid excessive nitrogen fertilization in early spring.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.organic_treatment: Spray Copper hydroxide @ 2g/L or Bordeaux mixture (1%) post-renovation.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.chemical_treatment: Apply Captan 50% WP @ 2.5g/L or Pyraclostrobin + Boscalid (Pristine) @ 1.5g/L at bloom and early leaf growth.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.prevention: Use certified disease-free strawberry runners and renew mulch annually.

hi.title: स्ट्रॉबेरी - पत्ती झुलसा (लीफ स्कॉर्च)
hi.action: पत्तियों के झुलसने पर कॉपर हाइड्रोक्साइड या कैप्टन कवकनाशी का छिड़काव करें।

gu.title: સ્ટ્રોબેરી - પાનનો કરચલો રોગ (લીફ સ્કોર્ચ)
gu.action: પાંદડા બળેલા દેખાય ત્યારે કેપ્ટાન અથવા કોપર દવાનો છંટકાવ કરો.

mr.title: स्ट्रॉबेरी - करपा / पानांची जळ

Strawberry___healthy.symptoms: Vibrant trifoliate serrated leaves, bright white flowers, and strong crown formation.
precautions: Use black plastic or clean straw mulch to keep fruit and leaves off soil.
Maintain adequate soil moisture with drip irrigation under plastic mulch.
Remove runners to concentrate crown vitality.
Strawberry___healthy.organic_treatment: Apply bio-fertilizers (Azotobacter, PSB) and seaweed extract.
Strawberry___healthy.chemical_treatment: No fungicide required. Balanced fertigation with potassium during berry sizing.
Strawberry___healthy.prevention: Raised bed planting and annual replanting rotation.

hi.title: स्ट्रॉबेरी - स्वस्थ पौधा
hi.action: पौधा स्वस्थ और फलने के लिए तैयार है। ड्रिप सिंचाई और मल्चिंग बनाए रखें।

gu.title: સ્ટ્રોબેરી - તંદુરસ્ત પાક
gu.action: પાક તંદુરસ્ત છે. ડ્રિપ પદ્ધતિથી નિયમિત પાણી આપો.

mr.title: स्ट्रॉबेरी - निरोगी पीक
mr.action: पीक निरोगी आहे. गादीवाफ्यावर प्लास्टिक मल्चिंग ठेवा.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.symptoms: Small, circular spots with dark brown margins and sunken grayish-white centers containing tiny black pycnidia specks.
precautions: Prune infected bottom leaves touching the ground.
Eliminate solanaceous weeds (nightshade, horsenettle) around field borders.
Do not work in tomato patches while foliage is wet from dew or rain.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.organic_treatment: Apply Copper Octanoate or Bacillus amyloliquefaciens biopesticide.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.chemical_treatment: Apply Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2g/L or Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L on a 7 to 10 day schedule.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.prevention: 3-year crop rotation and staking vines with plastic mulching.

hi.title: टमाटर - सेप्टोरिया पत्ती धब्बा रोग
hi.action: गोल भूरे धब्बों के बीच में सफेद केंद्र दिखने पर क्लोरोथैलोनिल या मेंकोजेब का छिड़काव करें।

gu.title: ટામેટા - સેપ્ટોરિયા પાન ટપકા રોગ
gu.action: કાળા-ભૂરા ટપકાં માટે ક્લોરોથેલોનિલ અથવા મેન્કોઝેબનો છંટકાવ કરો.

mr.title: टोमॅटो - सेप्टोरिया पानावरील ठिपके
mr.action: बारीक पांढऱ्या केंद्राच्या ठिपक्यांसाठी क्लोरोथॅलोनिल फवारा.

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.symptoms: Fine yellow or white stippling speckles on upper leaf surface; fine silky webbing on leaf undersides; leaves bronze, dry out, and drop.
precautions: Avoid excessive broad-spectrum synthetic pyrethroids that destroy natural predatory mites.
Knock off mite colonies with a high-pressure water spray during initial outbreaks.
Keep farm perimeter free of dusty weeds which harbor mite reservoirs.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.organic_treatment: Spray Neem oil (5ml/L) or release predatory phytoseiid mites (Phytoseiulus persimilis).
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.chemical_treatment: Apply Abamectin 1.9% EC @ 0.5ml/L or Spiromesifen 22.9% SC (Oberon) @ 1ml/L or Propargite 57% EC @ 2ml/L.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.prevention: Ensure overhead dust suppression and scout regularly with a 10x hand lens.

hi.title: टमाटर - दो-धब्बेदार मकड़ी (रेड स्पाइडर माइट)
hi.action: पत्तियों के नीचे बारीक जाले और पीले धब्बे दिखने पर नीम तेल या एबामेक्टिन (Abamectin) का छिड़काव करें।

gu.title: ટામેટા - લાલ કથીરી (સ્પાઇડર માઇટ્સ)
gu.action: પાંદડા નીચે જાળી માટે લીમડાનું તેલ અથવા એબામિક્ટીન છાંટો.

mr.title: टोमॅटो - लाल कोळी (स्पायडर माईट)
mr.action: बारीक जाळे आणि पिवळ्या ठिपक्यांसाठी अबामेक्टिन किंवा ओबेरॉनची फवारणी करा.

Tomato___Target_Spot.symptoms: Small brown pinpoint lesions expanding into large circular brown necrotic spots with subtle concentric rings and yellow halos.
precautions: Maintain optimal row spacing to maximize canopy ventilation.
Avoid handling wet plants to minimize physical spore dissemination.
Immediately destroy cull piles and post-harvest residues.
Tomato___Target_Spot.organic_treatment: Foliar spray with Copper Hydroxide or bio-fungicide Bacillus subtilis.
Tomato___Target_Spot.chemical_treatment: Apply Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1ml/L or Famoxadone + Cymoxanil (Tanos) or Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2g/L.
Tomato___Target_Spot.prevention: Use resistant hybrids, sanitize stakes, and rotate crops.

hi.title: टमाटर - टार्गेट स्पॉट (लक्ष्य धब्बा)
hi.action: गोल छल्लेदार भूरे धब्बों के लिए एजॉक्सीस्ट्रोबिन या क्लोरोथैलोनिल का छिड़काव करें।

gu.title: ટામેટા - ટાર્ગેટ સ્પોટ રોગ
gu.action: ગોળ ડાઘા માટે અઝોક્સીસ્ટ્રોબિન અથવા ક્લોરોથેલોનિલ છાંટો.

mr.title: टोमॅटो - टार्गेट स्पॉट
mr.action: चकतीसारख्या गोल ठिपक्यांसाठी अझॉक्सीस्ट्रॉबिन फवारा.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.pathogen: Tomato yellow leaf curl virus (Begomovirus vectored by Whitefly Bemisia tabaci)
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.symptoms: Severe upward leaf curling, cupping, yellowing of leaf margins (chlorosis), severe plant stunting, flower drop, and bushy appearance.
precautions: Install yellow sticky traps (30-40 traps/hectare) to monitor and capture whitefly vectors.
Erect 50-mesh nylon insect-proof net in nursery seedbeds.
Rogue out and destroy infected viral symptomatic plants immediately.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.organic_treatment: Spray 2% Neem oil or 5% NSKE (Neem Seed Kernel Extract) with liquid soap to repel whiteflies.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.chemical_treatment: Control whitefly vector with Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 1g/L or Dinotefuran 20% SG @ 0.5g/L or Acetamiprid 20% SP @ 0.3g/L.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.prevention: Sow TYLCV resistant hybrids (e.g. US-440, ToMV/TYLCV tolerant hybrids) and control weeds.

hi.title: टमाटर - पीला पत्ती मरोड़ विषाणु (TYLCV)
hi.action: यह सफेद मक्खी द्वारा फैलता है। पीले चिपचिपे कार्ड लगाएं और सफेद मक्खी नियंत्रण हेतु डायफेन्थियुरॉन या नीम तेल छिड़कें।

gu.title: ટામેટા - પાન વળવાનો વાયરસ (TYLCV)
gu.action: સફેદ માખી નિયંત્રણ માટે પીળા સ્ટીકી ટ્રેપ લગાવો અને ડાયાફેન્થિયુરોન છાંટો.

mr.title: टोमॅटो - पर्णगुच्छ / पिवळा विषाणू (TYLCV)
mr.action: पांढऱ्या माशीचा प्रादुर्भाव रोखण्यासाठी पिवळे चिकट सापळे लावा आणि डायफेंथ्युरॉन फवारा.

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.symptoms: Mottled light and dark green mosaic patterns on foliage, leaf distortion, 'shoestring' fern-like leaves, internal browning of fruit.
precautions: Sterilize hands, pruners, and stakes in 20% non-fat dry milk solution or 10% trisodium phosphate (TSP).
Prohibit tobacco smoking/chewing anywhere near the farm (tobacco harbors the virus).
Carefully rogue out and bury/incinerate symptomatic plants immediately.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.organic_treatment: Dip seeds in 10% Trisodium Phosphate (TSP) solution for 30 minutes before planting.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.chemical_treatment: No direct antiviral curative chemical exists. Strictly manage mechanical transmission and sanitize tools with bleach.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.prevention: Grow ToMV-resistant cultivars and practice strict nursery sanitation.

hi.title: टमाटर - मोज़ेक विषाणु (ToMV)
hi.action: यह छूने और औजारों से फैलता है। धूम्रपान न करें, औजारों को डेटॉल या दूध के घोल से धोएं और रोगी पौधों को तुरंत नष्ट करें।

gu.title: ટામેટા - મોઝેક વાયરસ (ToMV)

Soybean___Bacterial_blight.symptoms: Small, angular, water-soaked translucent yellow-to-brown spots with prominent chlorotic halos on soybean leaflets. Lesions may coalesce to form large ragged dead patches.
precautions: Do not cultivate, spray, or harvest when soybean foliage is wet with dew or rain to prevent bacterial spread.
Destroy or deep-plow infected soybean crop residue after harvest.
Rotate fields with non-host crops such as maize/corn or sorghum for at least one year.
Soybean___Bacterial_blight.organic_treatment: Spray Copper hydroxide @ 2g/L or Pseudomonas fluorescens / Bacillus subtilis bio-agent formulation @ 5g/L.
Soybean___Bacterial_blight.chemical_treatment: Spray Streptocycline @ 100 ppm (1g in 10L water) combined with Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5g/L at first appearance of spots.
Soybean___Bacterial_blight.prevention: Use certified disease-free soybean seed. Plant tolerant varieties (e.g., JS 335, JS 93-05, NRC 37).
